# EtrnL

**Identity manifold for multimodal presence, privacy, and continuity.**

EtrnL encodes voice, face, text, and context into a 128-dimensional learned manifold where encoding, generation, memory, and navigation are the same operation.

## Quick start

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate          # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

# Smoke test the core manifold
python -c "from etrnl.manifold import IdentityManifold; m = IdentityManifold(); print('ok')"

# Run tests
pytest tests/ -v
```

## Modules

| Module | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `manifold` | Identity encoding, generation, navigation, interpolation |
| `presence` | Cryptographic proof-of-presence challenge-response |
| `privacy` | Consent filtering and semantic privacy budgets |
| `gradient` | Five-level perspective gradient (VERBATIM → UNKNOWN) |
| `continuity` | Life continuity states: ACTIVE → DORMANT → GUARDIANSHIP → LEGACY |
| `holograph` | Holographic model fragmentation and reconstruction |
| `resonance` | Temporal resonance — memory reconstruction from manifold |
| `self_prove` | Self-proving architecture with continuous validation |

## Development

```bash
black etrnl/ tests/
ruff check etrnl/ tests/
pytest tests/ -v
```

## Cursor Gate

This repo includes the [Cursor Gate](https://github.com/zowskyy/Schema) stack for agent-driven code review. Gate reviewer deps live in `requirements-gate.txt`.

```bash
pip install -r requirements-gate.txt
bash scripts/install-agent-environment.sh
bash scripts/gate-file.sh --file samples/hello_passing.py
```

PR CI: workflow `Gate Check` runs the gate on `samples/hello_passing.py`.

## Layout

```
etrnl/              # Core Python package
tests/              # pytest suite (one file per module + integration)
docs/ROADMAP.md     # Gap audit and next milestones
scripts/            # Gate scripts + build helpers
... (5 more lines)
